subject: Q4 Architecture Review - Action Required Before Friday
body:
Hi team,

Please find the updated system design document for our Q4 architecture review. We need each team lead to submit their feedback by Friday 5:00 PM. Key areas of focus include microservices latency reduction and the new Agentic AI workflow integration.

Best,
Sarah

subject: Follow-up: Series B Due Diligence & Financial Metrics
body:
Dear founders,

Thanks for the productive discussion yesterday. Could you please share the monthly recurring revenue (MRR) breakdown and customer retention rates for the last two quarters? Our committee would like to review them before finalizing the term sheet next Tuesday.

Regards,
Marcus Vance

subject: Heads-Up: Scheduled PostgreSQL Cluster Maintenance this Sunday
body:
Hello everyone,

This is a notification that our primary PostgreSQL cluster will undergo maintenance this Sunday between 02:00 UTC and 04:00 UTC. Expect approximately 10-15 minutes of read-only mode during the failover.

Feel free to reach out on Slack #devops if you have concerns.
Alex

subject: Accepted Paper: Autonomous ReAct Agents in Production
body:
Dear colleague,

Our paper on Autonomous ReAct Agents in Production has been officially accepted for oral presentation at NeurAI 2026! Let's arrange a brief sync next week to coordinate slides.

Warm regards,
Dr. Elena

body:
